product.name: Delto Gripper SDK
product.description: Unified control SDK for DG-series grippers

versions.title: Delto Gripper SDK release
versions.summary: Delto Gripper SDK launches. DG-series grippers can now be controlled through a single, unified SDK.

items.text: Initial release of the unified SDK controlling DG-series grippers

versions.title: DG-3F-M control added
versions.summary: DG-3F-M can now be controlled. DG-5F control was refined and various bugs were fixed.

items.text: Added DG-3F-M control
Added gripper IP configuration
Optimized gripper setup and motion functions
Removed grasp-algorithm related options
Applied 2025-04-30 final review updates (see required fixes)

versions.title: Reconnect stabilization
versions.summary: Resolved program termination on reconnect attempts and unified callback behavior.

items.text: Fixed program termination on reconnect attempts
Unified disconnect callback on reconnect failure (user / developer)

versions.title: 3-finger envelope fix
versions.summary: Fixed an issue with the 3-finger envelope.

items.text: Fixed 3-finger envelope error

versions.title: Linux .so distribution and Aidin FT sensor
versions.summary: The SDK now ships a Linux Shared Object (.so). Added Aidin FT sensor features and new getter functions.

items.text: Linux library (.so) distribution
Added Aidin FT sensor features (sensor data receive, sensor init)
Added getters for existing callback parameters (recommended when using JS on Linux)
Added ReceivedGripperData getter
Added CommunicationPeriod getter
Added ReceivedFingertipSensorData getter
Added ReceivedGPIOData getter
Added DataProcessing and DiagnosisSystem getters

versions.title: GPIO and gripper-info stability
versions.summary: Fixed invalid GPIO input values and a developer-mode gripper model info load issue.

items.text: Fixed invalid values being accepted on GPIO input
Fixed gripper model info not loading in one shot in developer mode

versions.title: RTU backup stability
versions.summary: Fixed program termination during backup over RTU connections.

items.text: Fixed program termination during backup after RTU connection

versions.title: RTU return verification
versions.summary: Fixed return-value verification missing during RTU communication.

items.text: Fixed RTU communication not checking return values

versions.title: Ubuntu 22.04 support
versions.summary: The SDK now supports Ubuntu 22.04 as well.

items.text: Fixed backup / restore errors
Fixed comport size

versions.title: B-model signed current and Linux RTU compatibility
versions.summary: B-model current output is now signed, LowPassFilter can be disabled, and Linux RTU bugs are fixed. Compatible with DGManager 1.4.0 and later.

items.text: B-model current output now returns +/- values
LowPassFilter Alpha = 0 turns the filter off
Expanded comport array for Linux RTU (8 → 32)
Fixed SetGripperOption() causing jitter
Fixed MoveTCPFinger causing drift
Fixed user-mode iLimit being applied 10×
Fixed Linux RTU communication bug
Added DG-4F features
Added DG-4F base-joint position control and motion-time functions
Developer mode: data can now be received during SystemStop
Developer mode: duty send direction matches DH parameter direction
Fixed current control returning NaN

versions.title: DG-4F-M, DG-2F-M, DG-1F-M support
versions.summary: DG-4F-M, DG-2F-M, and DG-1F-M are now supported.

items.text: DG-4F-M kinematics and grasp algorithm complete
Added DG-4F-M base joint functions (Gain, position mode, …)
Added DG-2F-M kinematics and grasp algorithm
Added DG-1F-M kinematics
Fixed reconnect attempts not connecting properly
Fixed return error on joint / finger index input

versions.title: Kinematics fixes and processing speed improvements
versions.summary: Fixed DG-2F-M and DG-1F-M kinematics and improved DG-4F-M processing performance.

items.text: Fixed DG-2F-M, DG-1F-M kinematics
Improved DG-4F-M processing speed

versions.title: MotorDirection compatibility and current-limit tuning
versions.summary: MotorDirection now follows the DG-series firmware version, and current control can be applied per module.

items.text: MotorDirection aligned with DG-series firmware version
Lowered DG-3F-B current limit to 140mA
Added per-module current control (shares PositionMode from SetGraspData)

versions.title: DG-2F IP setup stabilization
versions.summary: Fixed an issue where the last IP-setting level on DG-2F reset to zero.

items.text: Fixed DG-2F IP setting final level value resetting to 0

versions.title: DG-5F-S series support and new fingertip sensors
versions.summary: Added DG-5F-S and DG-5F-S15 models and new FT/Tactile fingertip sensors. The grasp algorithm now scales dynamically based on the number of finger joints.

items.text: Added DG-5F-S, DG-5F-S15 models: kinematics, grasp algorithm
Fingertip sensors: added FT and Tactile
Added library (.dll, .so) version-check functions
Added module error codes
Position-control motion speed is now applied during grasp actions
Updated fingertip protocol
Added variables to fingerTipSensorData struct
Added ReceivedDataType and resized it
Grasp algorithm now computes based on joint count per finger
Fixed single-joint control releasing other joints
Restore function now resets to boot recipe on completion
Fixed typos in function and variable names
Fixed consecutive position-control calls losing target and motion speed

versions.title: DG-5F-S series support and new fingertip sensors
versions.summary: Added DG-5F-S and DG-5F-S15 models and new FT/Tactile fingertip sensors. The grasp algorithm now scales dynamically based on the number of finger joints.

items.text: Fixed decimal-place mismatch when receiving fingertip sensor data in developer mode (missing '/10')
